notablePrerequisites:
You control a Forest.
Freed from the Real attached to Arbor Elf.
You are the monarch.
description:
Activate a Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth's last ability triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping a Forest.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.
